title: Blue and Red Demons
description: A blue demon with horns kneels on the left and reaches with both hands to touch a glowing yellow crystal formation. A large red demon with a curved horn on its head kneels on the right and also touches the same crystals with its hands while more yellow crystals grow from its chest area.
